ai_summary: Action Construction Equipment Limited reported a robust Q2 FY27, achieving its best-ever performance with 20.5% year-on-year revenue growth and significantly expanded EBITDA margins, driven by disciplined commercial execution and strategic diversification into higher-value segments and defense. While management anticipates sustained revenue growth for FY27, persistent raw material inflation, particularly in steel, necessitates further calibrated price increases that could strain customer relationships, alongside managing currently elevated inventory levels primarily due to large government orders.
